title: Al-Buraq Uprising
excerpt: In August 1929, Palestinians rose in protest against attempts to seize control of the Al-Buraq Wall adjacent to Al-Aqsa Mosque. Over 116 Palestinians were martyred.
statExp: 116 Palestinian martyrs fell during the clashes, and three leaders were executed by British authorities.

title: Great Palestinian Rebellion
excerpt: The Great Rebellion began in April 1936 with a six-month general strike before evolving into armed resistance against British Mandate rule and Zionist expansion.
statExp: Thousands of martyrs and injured due to military operations and severe British repression.

title: Ethnic Cleansing of Palestine
excerpt: Early massacres and ethnic cleansing operations conducted under British Mandate protection preceding the official declaration of Israel.
statExp: Victims of early massacres and displacement preceding 1948.

title: Deir Yassin Massacre
excerpt: On April 9, 1948, Zionist militias raided Deir Yassin village west of Jerusalem, committing a brutal massacre of unarmed civilians.
statExp: Over 250 unarmed civilians including children, women, and elderly executed.

title: 1948 Arab-Israeli War
excerpt: The first major war following the end of the British Mandate and the declaration of Israel in May 1948.
statExp: Martyrs defending Palestinian cities, towns, and villages during the Nakba.

title: Occupation of Gaza 1956
excerpt: During the Suez Crisis, Israeli forces occupied the Gaza Strip, perpetrating major massacres in Khan Younis and Rafah.
statExp: Martyrs of Khan Younis and Rafah massacres during the 1956 aggression.

title: June 1967 War
excerpt: The Naksa resulting in the military occupation of the Gaza Strip, West Bank, East Jerusalem, Sinai, and Golan Heights.
statExp: Martyrs of military defense operations across Arab and Palestinian territories.

title: Land Day
excerpt: A popular uprising against the confiscation of thousands of dunams of Palestinian land in the Galilee and Triangle.
statExp: Six Palestinians martyred while defending their ancestral lands in 1948 territories.

title: First Palestinian Intifada
excerpt: A historic popular uprising originating in Jabalia refugee camp in Gaza that spread across all Palestinian cities.
statExp: Martyrs killed by military forces during popular protests and confrontations.

title: Ibrahimi Mosque Massacre
excerpt: An extremist shooting inside the Ibrahimi Mosque in Hebron during dawn prayers.
statExp: 29 worshippers martyred inside the holy mosque during dawn prayers.

title: Second Palestinian Intifada
excerpt: Sparked following Sharon's provocation at Al-Aqsa, leading to extensive military invasions across West Bank and Gaza.
statExp: Over 4,000 documented martyrs during the Al-Aqsa Intifada.

title: 2014 Gaza War
excerpt: A 51-day military aggression on the Gaza Strip resulting in widespread devastation and mass family casualties.
statExp: Over 2,200 martyrs including hundreds of children and women.

title: Al-Aqsa Flood & Comprehensive War
excerpt: The ongoing genocidal war and unprecedented military aggression against Gaza, West Bank, and the wider region.
statExp: Over 158,000 to 291,000 martyrs, injured, missing, and trapped under rubble in the ongoing war.
sourceName: Palestinian Central Bureau of Statistics & UN Reports
